summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Capital Markets Day 2026 press release. The company announced a doubling of its 2026 share buy-back to USD 3 billion and introduced a predictable buy-back framework of USD 2-4 billion annually from 2027. It also aims for over 5% annual growth in quarterly cash dividends per share. These capital return initiatives are part of Equinor's strategy to deliver superior returns, with a target of ROACE above 15% from 2026-2030. No external advisors or board recommendations were mentioned. The programs are subject to oil price assumptions and balance sheet strength. Watch for execution against production and cash flow growth targets.
